about_short_description.short_description: DeepL is a software company that offers a communication platform for AI based translation, editing, and writing services.

product.name: DeepL Translator
product.description: An AI-powered translation service for text, files, images, and speech across more than 100 languages, with tools for terminology and writing context.

product.name: DeepL API
product.description: An API-driven language service that enables developers and organizations to integrate DeepL translation and writing capabilities into software, websites, and automated workflows.

product.name: DeepL Voice
product.description: A real-time speech translation service for multilingual meetings and in-person conversations, supporting cross-language communication through translated spoken content.

product.name: DeepL Write
product.description: An AI writing assistant that improves business text by refining wording and adapting style and tone for a target audience or brand.

product.name: DeepL Integrations
product.description: Connections that embed DeepL language technology into productivity and communication tools, including Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, Google Workspace, and web browsers.
